rowRule: One entry per printed text row. 'rids' are the candidate rows (data/reference-rows-candidates.json) that read it; where one candidate covers two printed rows (R063, R077) the row is suffixed a/b and its box is built from the members that match its text.
annotationRule: Rows that form one callout, note, bubble or elevation marker share an annotation id, listed top to bottom (vertical text: left to right).
regionRule: trueRegion is title_block for x >= 2300 pt (the title-block border seen in A15/A25/A45), otherwise drawing.
technicalRule: Stage 04: annotation category dimension/dimension_note/elevation/sheet_reference/reference_note, or the row text rule.
